nom: Vichy LiftActiv Hyaluronic Specialist H.A. Day Cream

avis.titre: The cream peels off my face!
avis.texte: I believed Vichy was a reputable French brand, but unfortunately my experience was extremely disappointing. I purchased the cream as part of my anti-aging routine. After cleansing my face and applying the cream, I noticed that within a few hours—even with very gentle rubbing—the product begins to peel off my skin. This is completely unacceptable. The cream provides no hydration and fails to perform as intended. Instead of absorbing, it flakes and rolls off, something I have never experienced with any skincare product. I had used Estee Lauder, it cosmetics,Shiseido, and this has never happened! I would not purchase this again! It doesn't even deserve a one star!

I have been using this moisturizer for several years and I absolutely LOVE it. The texture, the fragrance, the quality of this creme is perfect for me. I have tried many other products but always come back to Vichy. The best!!!

Love Ulta's GWPs! I've discovered so many holy grail products from their deluxe sample GWPs. Vichy says their products are "Suitable for Sensitive Skin" - which i have. Unfortunately this moisturizer reeks of cheap PERFUME. The smell doesn't disappate snd it made my skin ITCH. Had to wash it off within 10 minutes. Why perfume Vichy? I couldn't even use it as a hand cream.

I've been using this for a couple years and have loved it. The new formula isn't as good. The one thing I loved about the previous formula is it played well with my other skin care and makeup. No pilling at all. The new formula pills which is very disappointing. It pilled after toner and again when I used my primer.

avis.titre: NOT noncomedogenic (it clog the pores f/oily skin)
avis.texte: Not, Is not suitable for normal to oily skin, as they state, much less for plainly oily/combined skin. VICHY should explicit recognize that is NOT noncomedogenic, it means, it CAN and will clog the pores so this cream is forbidden to use even by mistake in the nights (if it happens you will surely wake up with a un acne outbreak). During the day it doesn't feel bad but as the hours pass you will look shine. Doesn't have UV prot. by itself so imagine all the layers you have to put over the already saturated skin. Good and Subtle fragrance, skin smoothy to the touch when applying.
I'm loving all my new Vichy skincare products! This cream absorbs quickly and leaves your skin silky, smooth. I've noticed a difference in my skin tone, less fine lines, more plumpness, youth look.

avis.titre: Would be my holy grail but...
avis.texte: I was absolutely blown away & saw a difference within tne first 2 weeks on my fine lines. I just turned 50 last year & habe been tryimg a lot of different products. It would be my holy grail if it didn't advertise it was cruelty free when it's not. I shoukd habe researched & not taking the filters word that it was not tested on animals. I will use up the jar & sadly need to find something else. It is thick, but not too much in my opinion since it absorbs quickly & smooths skin so nicely. I don't understand some people complaining anout the scent but everyone is different; I find it light & very pleasant. I did not notice any lifting but as with any product you need to give it at least 8 weeks....

avis.titre: Experience the lift benefit of this moisturizer.
avis.texte: This is a perfect moisturizer for my skin, and I can feel the lift specially on my forehead.
Very light crème. Absorbs instantly. Leaves skin soft, silky and smelling amazing.
I placed an order, but more than two weeks have passed and the status of my order is "new". This is very sad and time-consuming... next time I'll think about where to order... unpleasant

avis.titre: Solid moisture barrier that's not greasy
avis.texte: So perhaps I'm not seeing full benefits because I don't have the full line of supporting serums and toners, but I'm not seeing a lifting response in my skin; I AM however seeing motorized skin and not blemishes in response. The formula also is slightly sweet, which I find when I lick my lip and catch the edge of skim around, so that's pleasant 😊

Absolutely love it!!! Game changer for sure. Leaves my face feeling so moisturized and soft. I have sensitive skin and have trouble finding products that won't irritate my skin. I found this moisturizer and am never going back.
First time trying it i hope i like it snd if i do i will stsred to buying product from loreal

I love this cream and have always had good results. I haven't used it in a couple of years, but now that I'm 45 and my skin appears not as firm, I decided to resume using this cream again. Hoping for the same great results I had when I previously used this product.

OMG I opened the jar and was overwhelmed by the sweet flower perfumy smell. I put a dab on my index finger and had to wash it off immediately. It's one of those heavy perfumy smells that stays with you and not in a good way. I don't know if the product does what it says it does or not - because of the strong perfumy scent I can't get close enough to it to try it. I will be returning this product.
Love this emollient like facial creme. Works like they said. Have to leave it "soak" in or it rools, but that is far outside the pros. It is wonderfully soft as is my skin.
Love this! Makes my skin feel hydrated and firmer and smells wonderful.

avis.titre: Great non-greasy formula for dry skin.
avis.texte: I have super dry skin, oddly enough in my t-zone. My skin often flakes between my brows. I used to have oily skin, but has changed since aging. I don't like really greasy or heavy moisturizers to wear during the day, so this one was perfect. It makes my skin feel super soft but I'm not shining like a beacon in the night. I will warn that it does have a fairly strong scent, but it's very fresh. I use this under my makeup and it doesn't disrupt it if I let it sit for a moment to sink in. I recommend it for anyone that likes to go bare face, but wants to look moisturized without looking shiny or greasy.
Very poor product. Does not work. I would not purchase any items from this company.

avis.titre: Too highly perfumed and not as moisturizing
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product but it was way too highly perfumed. I just could not get past the small. Also, I did not find it as moisturizing as I had hoped. It was OK. I sadly had to call and request a return.

This face cream is amazing! It is very thick and hydrating without being greasy. I absolutely love it. Better than most luxury brands at a fraction of the cost. Makes my face and neck smooth and firm!

When it comes to moisturizers, there can be good ones that are super expensive, and also good ones that are quite affordable. This one is great and affordable as well. It is super hydrating for my dry skin in the winter and it's also very gentle. It also works as a great base for my foundation￼

This cream feels wonderful on the skin. I possess Normal to Oily skin and this product does not leave a heavy or greasy feel. My only complaint is that it does not contain sunscreen, therefore it's not suitable for daytime use as stated on the jar and this website.
Great cream.I haven't been using that long to see results but I love the texture, the smell and How soft my skin feels.
I've loved every vichy product I've ever tried, and that's quite a few. Like their other products, this sinks into the skin nice& quick. It didn't make my combo skin look shiny either.
This is good by itself but each time i tried putting makeup over it it would "flake" and look like peeling skin or something… i am returning for this reason. Again, by itself i liked it

I really love this! I got a sample in a free 27 piece makeup gift from Ulta for spending so much money. I am in love with the scent. It is very hydrating and does not leave your face shiny or greasy. I can't speak on fine lines or aging yet bc I haven't used it long enough but i'll check back in a few wks…will definitely purchase the full size though!! Btw I am a first time user of Vichy…..SATISFIED!

I'm trying to pick out product for my 40+ skin. This is nice and not greasy. It is lightly scented and is pleasant. I like that it can be purchased anywhere at a local drug store. Price point is good and for some reason I'm always coming back to this serum.

I got a sample and I have a pretty solid skincare routine but I liked the overall look of the glass jar so I said why not. IT BURNS. 😭 I can't see a difference just yet I've been using it only for almost about a week but geez… I mix it with my first aid beauty moisturizer 🧴 I didn't want to completely switch it out for this and I was like maybe it's my skin that's not use to it… no it still kinda stings 🥲 but I feel like it's doing what it needs to and the feel of it is amazing (other then you know THE STING) I'll have to keep trying and decide by then if I want to buy the full size
This is amazing it leaves my face feeling so refreshed especially with the woes of the day. With the constant aging of my face I love that this product does the trick
Not as creamy or moisturizing as I anticipated. Smell stronger than like and not as much of a value for amount/quality.

I really like the moisturizer. It has a high end fragrance that's giving the spa feel, it has a very nice texture and goes into the skin super fast. I love it for a night moisturizer but it goes well for days as well. I'm waking up and everything looks fresh. Definitely recommend.

I got a sample jar in a gift bag from Ulta. I loved the packaging and the reviews. This burns my face. I've been using it up as hand cream and it even sort of stings my hands. The smell is intense like flowers, and baby dolls from the 80s. Love the fancy glass jar and hate basically everything else.
It is not heavily greasy, but moisturizes really well and has a pleasant scent. I've noticed a reduction in fine lines and smaller pores. Love this product!

I think about this products is one of the best. The Vichy liftActiv Supreme is one of the best to repair facial skin. In addition to moisturizing and taking care of it. I recommend to other to use it!

I got a free sample of this that I like as much if not more than my much more expensive regular moisturizer. I have used it for a couple of weeks and can feel a difference in the texture of my skin. I will be saving money and buying this next time I purchase moisturizer.

I really like the Vichy LiftActiv Supreme moisturizer. I have sensitive and dry skin so its hard to find a moisturizer that both hydrates well and doesn't break my skin out. I do have the full-size of this product (easier to hold the sample) and have been using it for a few months now, I can't really say it has done much for my wrinkles but since I was more concerned with hydration it works for what i bought it for. My only complaint is that i can really only use it at night as it seems to pill on my face and doesn't absorb well enough to go on under makeup. All in all I will continue to buy until I can find something better.
after two days use a big bubble appeared making the container 1/2 empty
Amazing product. Keeps my skin feeling hydrated and plump! It has a scent but not too strong
Amazing product. I can tell the difference in my skin in as little as a week. Excited I have found this brand!

Many people credit this serum as one of the great, affordable anti-aging products— and it's not for no reason! This is a great product that both my mother and I use and it has great benefits for both our skin types.
Fresh and lovely. It was a quick add to my routine. I'm not sure about the long term effects yet, but I feel optimistic
My go-to moisturizer for keeping acne prone skin plump and healthy
Very good for dry skin my T zone of my face dries up very soon but after a week of application saw a difference with my face .my face was hydrated and fresh thanks vichy for the amazing product

used Vichy LiftActiv for more than a year. ... I've used Vichy LiftActiv for more than a year. It's light, luscious, and does what it says it will do with daily use. The scent is light and clean, not at all perfumery.
Cream is ok. But the smell is too strong and unpleasant to me. I will not buy it again.
Great smooth feeling and smells amazing its a bit pricey but worth it my skin feels like silk when i use it

Vichy liftactiv supreme is my moms favourite product, I gifted her the whole line of liftactiv for her birthday and she never used something else after that,it really helps mom to look younger than she really is , 100% recommend
It really helps the aging skin. Lines are definitely less. I've been using it for years and years.
Very moisturizing, however I am not very fond of the smell. I wish it came in different scents to choose from or even an unscented variety.

Good product , really good and Perfect for my skin now , I usually use this before my makeup and is really good in the day so I recommend this product every day is very friendly with the skin I love it
It's thick and creamy didn't get to see results usted it to to bed and woke up with my fave still smooth !
Hydrating and effective daily moisturizer. I use it before my sunscreen.

Love this light, anti-aging cream. It works on me. I have bought this product over and over. I notice a big difference in my skin when I use it. I feel I have gotten better results with this face cream. This is a cream that has alot of high quality ingredients

I've been using this face cream day and night for over 25 years. At first I could only buy it in Europe, but am happy to find it in the US now. It hydrates without making my face shiny. I'm often complimented on the youthfulness of my skin and I owe that to Vichy LiftActiv. Thanks for a great product.

I have used quite a lot Vichy products and I was happy with them but this one is horrible. When I opened it for the first time, there was an air bubble inside the jar making it 3/4 full. It's weirdly sweet when it happens to get on my lips, has the smell of cheap face cream, and it just does not work for my skin.
It gives my skin a natural glow. It's not heavy, it absorbs nicely and doesn't make you look greasy, but I can feel greasy a little bit. Has a nice light scent. Love, love this moisturizer!

I previously used Vichy Aqualia Thermal Rich but recently switched to LiftActiv Supreme. Unfortunately, the LiftActiv Supreme leaves my face looking dry, and makeup tends to accentuate the lines in my face. I will go back to using the Aqualia Thermal Rich cream.

Too early to tell, but my skin is liking it so far. It did not give me that skin glass glow that I am accustomed to from Korean moisturizers, but it is hydrating still and gives me that glow. And it does not give me that tight feeling, especially during mid-afternoon. I will be repurchasing.

I think my skin looks tighter when I'm wearing it. It feels nice and there's a nice smell, although by the end of the day I'm tired of smelling it (I'm pretty sensitive to smells). Got it for long-term anti-aging hopes, but good so far!
I love how it makes my skin feel and the glow it has after applying it. Love it and can definitely say it's one of my favorites.

Amazing cream foe my sensitive skin, even when it's scented! It's light weight, melts into skin quickly, does not leave sticky or oily feeling, and provides very good hydration and smoothness throughout the day.
I use it all the time for my face to moisturize my skin I use it twice a day I recommend this to everyone
Hydrating and nutritional, make my skin comfortable, and reasonable price, will buy it back, recommend to try!

This anti aging cream is amazing its so thick and creamy and buttery highly effective my skin looked and felt amazing after using this in my daily routine im a guy buy care about skin care and the majority of "for men" skin care products can not hold a candle to higher end "womens" facial products would definitely buy again
I've been using this cream forever! Very good hydrating cream that k personally like over the night one (I find it less heavy and more hydrating). Can't live without it!

Love, love this moisturizer! This makes my skin look smoother and healthier. I get compliments all the time when I'm wearing this alone. It gives my skin a natural glow. It's not heavy, it absorbs nicely and doesn't make you look greasy. Has a nice light scent.

My first impression of this product was very good. The packaging is very nice and feels luxurious. The product itself is perfumed, which may be a turnoff to some, but it's a plus for me. It feels very nice on the skin and when applied before going to bed leaves my face feeling refreshed all the way until morning.
This is the most emollient cream I have ever put on my face! It feels so good going on and is light and the smell is amazing!

I've only been using this for 2 weeks but so far I love it! Moderate consistency that melts into the skin in 5 minutes! No stickiness but hydrating. Mild, pleasant scent and it workd for my sensitive skin. I'm really hoping it'll continue to work long-term then I for sure will repurchase.

Love it! The Vichy line has transformed my face - my skin looks and feels great, and my fine lines and age spots have diminished. I use this during the day after my regular skincare routine as my final step. It only takes a little bit to cover your face and neck.

I started using this product because it was suggested by the Skin Consultant AI of Vichy and I have to admit I could not see a difference between it and the moisturizer that I used to buy which is a lot cheaper than this.
I'm not in love with the scent. I should have returned it! But if you don't mind the scent the product is ok.
Been using the sample for the past few days. I love the scent. Its a great daytime moisturizer and you dont need a lot of it. Glides on nicely. Keeps my skin moist through out the day!

avis.titre: Super Hydrating and Skin Feels Lifted
avis.texte: I trust Vichy as a brand and have used their other products before. I received the Vichy LiftActiv Supreme complimentary of Bzzagent and tested it for almost a month. It feels so luxe and light on the skin, which I love as a nightly routine. I love that it is paraben-free and allergy-tested. I once has a terrible allergy reaction with Origins serum, so I am often wary about switching anti-aging creams. It definitely helped increase skin firmness for me which is often a problem when you lose skin elasticity due to aging.

I have used a Vichy product previously (a night cream) that I really enjoyed, so I was excited to try this "day" cream. It was extremely moisturizing, smelled nice, and felt lovely on my face. I can't speak to how well it worked from a firming/wrinkle-reducing/etc. standpoint. These are things that take a lot of time to see noticeable results, and I will keep using it to see if anything happens!

I've used this for about two weeks now and I like it. It's definitely a thicker daytime face lotion/cream, but I live in Utah where it's really dry in the winter so I like it. I also agree with other reviews that a little goes a long way! I don't think I've used it long enough to notice any improvement in wrinkles, but it's definitely firming and my face is super soft. I want to try the night version. Love the ingredients, excited to keep using it.

I have used a Vichy product previously (a night cream) that I really enjoyed, so I was excited to try this "day" cream. It was extremely moisturizing, smelled nice, and felt lovely on my face. I can't speak to how well it worked from a firming/wrinkle-reducing/etc. standpoint. These are things that take a lot of time to see noticeable results, and I will keep using it to see if anything happens!

avis.titre: Very light and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Very hydrating while being light for sensitive skin with no fragrance, kept my skin plump and hydrated

This is an amazing day cream if you are concerned about fine lines and wrinkles. I'm in my 30s and always looking to incorporate new things into my skincare routine. I am very concerned about fine lines in my forehead and this helps a lot. It is also very easy to apply and moisturizes pretty good. I highly recommend it as it is high quality and there's a visible difference after a couple of weeks using it

It doesn't have a strong scent which is nice. I'm not a fan of the packaging- I wish it was a pump instead of a jar. It feels good to apply to the skin, but I didn't notice any changes in my skin vs other similar products I have used before.

I'm already a big fan of Vichy so I was very excited to finally try the LIFTACTIV SUPREME Firming Anti-Aging Cream. This is a thick, almost balm-like moisturizer that sinks in quickly & dries down to a non-sticky finish. It works well with other products without any pilling & I really appreciate how it goes not have my skin sticking to my pillow case. After using this cream for a few weeks I can honestly say that I already see improvements in the firmness of my skin & it does a fabulous job of leaving my skin moisturizer & supple.

I'm so grateful to have received this complementary product. I've always heard wonderful things about it and it live dip to the hype. My skin is looking awesome and I so wish I had the opportunity to try more products.

It doesn't have a strong scent which is nice. I'm not a fan of the packaging- I wish it was a pump instead of a jar. It feels good to apply to the skin, but I didn't notice any changes in my skin vs other similar products I have used before.

This is an amazing day cream if you are concerned about fine lines and wrinkles. I'm in my 30s and always looking to incorporate new things into my skincare routine. I am very concerned about fine lines in my forehead and this helps a lot. It is also very easy to apply and moisturizes pretty good. I highly recommend it as it is high quality and there's a visible difference after a couple of weeks using it

I'm already a big fan of Vichy so I was very excited to finally try the LIFTACTIV SUPREME Firming Anti-Aging Cream. This is a thick, almost balm-like moisturizer that sinks in quickly & dries down to a non-sticky finish. It works well with other products without any pilling & I really appreciate how it goes not have my skin sticking to my pillow case. After using this cream for a few weeks I can honestly say that I already see improvements in the firmness of my skin & it does a fabulous job of leaving my skin moisturizer & supple.
I love the smell of this cream. The jar is perfect for gripping and quickly taking a dab. The cream makes my skin feel smooth and looks dewy.

One of the things I liked most about this cream was that it was lightweight. A little goes a long way- I put a little on my fingers and patted it on my face, then lightly rubbed it in. I also like that it isn't heavily scented. This formula absorbs well into the skin and my skin feels smoother and firmer after use. My fine lines look softer after using as well.

Thick cream, smells really good but I don't see any results that I can drastically say WOW, I need this in my life forever or it is a HOLY GRAIL. I will continue to use it until the jar is empty but really don't think it has been of much difference to my skin.

avis.titre: Very light and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Very hydrating while being light for sensitive skin with no fragrance, kept my skin plump and hydrated

avis.titre: Can see a difference in 2 weeks!
avis.texte: I've been using LiftActiv Supreme everyday for two weeks, and I can already see and feel a difference in my skin! I have a daily morning and evening routine, and simply added this to it. My crows feet are now less noticeable and my skin looks noticeably firmer/lifted. I love it! I also like that it feels like it is absorbing into my skin, and not just a grease that sits on my skin. I will continue to add this to my routine and will recommend this to my friends and family. Love it!
I love how this products leaves my face feeling so hydrated and soft. I love how moisturized my face feels.

I'm so grateful to have received this complementary product. I've always heard wonderful things about it and it live dip to the hype. My skin is looking awesome and I so wish I had the opportunity to try more products.

I've tried a range of Vichy products and they never disappoint! From the smell, to the texture, to the results — you can't go wrong! This product is great and I love how it fits so perfectly into my morning routine.

I'm one of those people who tries out all kinds of face serums and creams to see if they really work and most of the time I am disappointed. They are overpriced and do not work well...but NOT this one! I saw results the next morning after applying at night. My forehead "frown" lines are MUCH less noticeable thanks to this product!!

Super nourishing and moisturizing. This is my first time trying an anti wrinkle cream because I just recently turned 30 and you know we have to be proactive about skincare at this age! Anyways, my skin is super sensitive and tend to turn red with harsh ingredients but not this one which was such a relief. Also I suffer from dry skin but this worked like magic. After about a months use my face definitely felt more supple than before. I will continue to include this in my skin care routine.

I've been using Vichy LiftActiv Supreme Anti Aging cream for few weeks and definitely feel that my skin is getting more firm and hydrated then before. It's lightweight and the texture is amazing. A little bit of cream goes a long way. This product is perfect for anyone who is starting to worry about their face aging.

The Vichy Liftactiv Supreme Firming Cream is a welcome addition to my skincare routine. After a few weeks of use, I've noticed that this cream adds moisture to my skin and gives a firm look to my cheeks. It is a thick cream that spreads out into a thin consistency. It feels lightweight on my skin. I will continue to use to check for anti-aging benefits.

I love the smell of this cream. The jar is perfect for gripping and quickly taking a dab. The cream makes my skin feel smooth and looks dewy.

I like this product . I've been looking for a product to make my skin look more radiant and I think this does a good job at it.

I've tried a range of Vichy products and they never disappoint! From the smell, to the texture, to the results — you can't go wrong! This product is great and I love how it fits so perfectly into my morning routine.

After a few weeks of use, I've noticed that this cream adds moisture to my skin and gives a firm look to my cheeks. It is a thick cream that spreads out into a thin consistency. It feels lightweight on my skin. I will continue to use to check for anti-aging benefits.
This cream feels delightful on my skin. Rich and moisturizing, but not too heavy. My skin feels younger already!
I love this product! It has such a nice natural smell nothing too over extreme. My skin feels so soft after just one use!!

Liftactiv Supreme daily cream is nice. It's really lightweight and not greasy at all. My skin felt really soft. This cream will last a long time...A little goes a long way. As a daily moisturizer I think it can be a good addition to your personal skincare routine. I don't feel like I saw any improvement in the appearance of wrinkles.

I've been using Vichy LiftActiv Supreme Anti Aging cream for few weeks and definitely feel that my skin is getting more firm and hydrated then before. It's lightweight and the texture is amazing. A little bit of cream goes a long way. This product is perfect for anyone who is starting to worry about their face aging.

Super nourishing and moisturizing. This is my first time trying an anti wrinkle cream because I just recently turned 30 and you know we have to be proactive about skincare at this age! Anyways, my skin is super sensitive and tend to turn red with harsh ingredients but not this one which was such a relief. Also I suffer from dry skin but this worked like magic. After about a months use my face definitely felt more supple than before. I will continue to include this in my skin care routine.

So I've been on the hunt for a cream that can stand up to the Winter (when I do go outside) that isn't greasy or heavy and I think I've found it. My skin drinks this up and there isn't any residue to speak of after a few minutes. All of the Anti-Aging properties (I didn't know much about rhamrose but love that it's naturally sourced) but I've definitely noticed the few fine lines I've noticed are plumped and my overall tone bright when I use this cream. I'll be restocking and it will actually replace my current night cream...

I received this sample of Vichy Liftactiv Supreme and I have been so excited to try it out. I first noticed the light and very non offensive smell of the lotion. My skin has been dry this winter and the lotion was very hydrating. I do feel the lotion is a bit greasy so I will be using at night mainly. I almost feel a "tingle" on my face when I use it, which makes me feel like it's working some kind of magic. I feel that for this price point this lotion is definitely worth the purchase. I will recommend to my friends that are looking for an aging cream. I will more than likely replace this product.

The LiftActiv Supreme day cream by Vichy has worked wonders for my skin. While I've only been using it for a couple of weeks now, I can already feel the difference. My skin feels hydrated without being oily, and appears firmer than when I first began using the product.

So I haven't been able to use this as much as I would like to, but when I have used it I've enjoyed how it makes my skin feel. I was pretty worried when I felt how thick this moisturizer was but I was pleasantly surprised when it sank it to my skin super fast and didn't leave me feeling greasy. Overall I plan to keep using this product because it keeps my skin nicely moisturized.

I cannot praise this liftactiv cream enough! It has definitely made my beauty routine much better. I like how smooth it is, not thick or greasy at all. It has a very nice scent to it, not too overwhelming.

I got this sent in exchange for my review. I used it as a neck cream due to the issue that it has alcohol pretty high up on the ingredients lists and therefore can be drying. I didn't experience said drying on my neck but no visible improvement either. Overall not a bad cream but it's not my new HG either

My mom has always told me it's never too early to start worrying about skincare and wrinkles. This product is amaaaazing. After about a week of using it I can already tell the difference. It smells so nice and goes on super smoothly. It also doesn't irritate my skin and I have super sensitive skin. It lifted my skin up and made it look plump and gave it a healthy glow. I'd have to use it more to see long term effects but as of now I'd recommend this to everyone! Going to buy a bottle of this for my mom too!!
Love how soft my face feels after using this, and it feels tighter too. Pricey, would like to see more results before I opt to buy

I love Vichy cosmetics. This cream is my new favorite!I have used many different moisturizers and this one is completely different!It perfectly fits my over dried skin. It hydrates, smooths and instantly feel it untightening my skin! My face looks soft all day!! The smell is really great! Completely in love!!!
I like this product . I've been looking for a product to make my skin look more radiant and I think this does a good job at it.

As a daily moisturizer I think it can be a good addition to your personal skincare routine. I don't feel like I saw any improvement in the appearance of wrinkles.
